integrity: Complete elementary proof and standalone finite checker are included. Verification is a same-model review, not external certification or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite linear words (c_0...c_{q-1})^k where q>=3 letters are distinct and k>=2.
It does not classify repeated-run periods or arbitrary nonoptimal attractors.
Unindexed equivalent prior results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Every smallest string attractor of a repeated permutation word
